metadata.name: Archaeological Radiocarbon Dating Records from Malaysia
metadata.description: A compilation of 335 archaeological radiocarbon dating records from Malaysia, primarily from the states of Sarawak (58%) and Sabah (42%). The dataset contains site metadata, dating methods (94% Radiocarbon), raw and calibrated age values, and laboratory information. The data is heavily concentrated at the Gua Niah site (31%). Ages are stored as numeric values in thousands of years BP (ka BP).
metadata.spatial: Point locations at archaeological sites in Malaysia (Country and Province level)
metadata.temporal: Radiocarbon ages in thousands of years BP (ka BP), ranging from 0.008 to 49.91 ka
